description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing user verified resources, including email and phone verification processes, such as requesting verification codes, verifying codes, and retrieving verified resource data.

classes.name: UserVerifiedResourcesController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling endpoints for user verified resources, including email and phone verification workflows.

methods.name: requestEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send email verification code.

methods.name: requestPhoneVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles request to send phone verification code.

methods.name: verifyPhoneNumber
methods.description: Verifies phone number with provided code.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves list of verified emails for user.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves list of verified phone numbers for user.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmailById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific verified email by ID.

methods.name: getVerifiedPhoneById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific verified phone number by ID.
